# Wavefield

- Author and copyright holder: Niko Dellic, © 2026.
- Source: https://github.com/niko-dellic/wavefield
- Pinned revision: `3858a657190ebd09bee704caa094e7e1fd3c6cc2`
- Licence: MIT. The complete notice is bundled as `Sources/Resources/Wavefield-LICENSE.txt`.

Lunalyr's **Wavefield** and **Wavefield Sphere** adapt the upstream Default template's free-plate field, interference and harmonic terms, domain warp, and Turbo heatmap. Wavefield uses the circular flat projection and its fisheye. Wavefield Sphere selects the upstream triplanar surface projection at its stock 42° view, radius and camera distance. The original template is retained in this directory. The native fragment shader uses analytic sphere intersection in place of Three.js's proxy mesh.

The exact upstream sources at the pinned revision are:

- [Default preset](https://github.com/niko-dellic/wavefield/blob/3858a657190ebd09bee704caa094e7e1fd3c6cc2/src/templates/default.json)
- [Field, projection, noise and colour](https://github.com/niko-dellic/wavefield/tree/3858a657190ebd09bee704caa094e7e1fd3c6cc2/src/webgl/shaders)
- [Camera setup](https://github.com/niko-dellic/wavefield/blob/3858a657190ebd09bee704caa094e7e1fd3c6cc2/src/webgl/ModalFieldRenderer.ts)
- [Peak analysis, atlas, modal projection, bank and ambient frame](https://github.com/niko-dellic/wavefield/tree/3858a657190ebd09bee704caa094e7e1fd3c6cc2/src/audio)

The Swift adaptation reads Lunalyr's existing windowed FFT and supplies Wavefield's spectral peaks and band energy alongside Lunalyr's onset envelopes. Both projections share Lunalyr's live system capture, animation clock, colour richness, audio sensitivity, Reduce Motion handling, and adaptive resolution. The desktop sphere has a fixed viewpoint. The adaptation includes the Default look, surface projection and ambient field. Other templates, the volume renderer, browser UI and demo music are outside this port.

## Original engine

**Wavefield Original** bundles the same upstream revision's WebGL renderer, FFT and temporal analysis, modal field, preset transitions, camera wander, and all 15 stock templates. `lunalyr-engine.ts` is the desktop entry point. It feeds Wavefield a bounded window of system audio from the stronger channel, uses a slow ambient view when capture is unavailable or quiet, and draws on Lunalyr's wallpaper clock. System audio stays in memory on the Mac. The host selects presets and projection and limits the render resolution. Lunalyr slightly softens audio transients and slows camera drift and pattern changes for desktop use.

The self-contained `Sources/Resources/WavefieldEngine.html` and its picker catalogue are generated by `Scripts/build-wavefield-engine.sh /path/to/wavefield` with Node 24 and npm. The script builds from the pinned revision and its npm lock. The engine runs offline. It excludes the original browser controls and sample tracks.

The WebGL bundle includes Three.js 0.184.0 (MIT) and postprocessing 6.39.1 (zlib). Their complete notices are bundled as `Sources/Resources/Wavefield-Web-Dependencies-LICENSE.txt`.

## Desktop safety and readability

`lunalyr-engine.ts` adds two frame fields and retunes some presets:

- `calm` (Reduce Motion or Dim Flashing Lights) zeroes beat, pulse, change and onsets before and after the modal engine, runs the modal engine at a quarter of real time so patterns morph slowly, and stops the sensitivity from amplifying energy. `punch` scales the remaining beat and pulse (1 keeps the previous 85%). Lunalyr's host also limits how fast the page's mean brightness may rise while calm (`WebVisualizerView.drawScript`).
- Some presets are retuned so white lyrics stay readable. The choice comes from renders in WebKit with music and in the ambient (no audio) field, flat and on the sphere, not from the template values: several light background colours never reach the screen, because the trails' blend mode darkens them. Black on Red, CRT, Grid, Knicks in 6 and Microsoft Excel did fill the screen with red or a light colour (mean relative luminance 0.17 to 0.89), so their background becomes a dark colour and the light colour draws the pattern. Lightning and Matrix washed the ambient field out (0.6 and 0.47), so they draw at 0.6 and 0.8 brightness with bloom 1 and 1.25. Devil rendered almost black, so it now draws its red pattern on black with screen-blended trails. Alien, Bands, Default, Green Flame, Infection, Running Shoes and Skeleton Seizure already rendered dark with a visible pattern and keep upstream's settings; Skeleton Seizure is listed as Skeleton. Every preset now measures at most about 0.07 mean luminance with music and 0.16 in the ambient field, with no full-screen red and no full-frame flashes; `WavefieldWebTests` renders each one to keep it that way. Preset ids are unchanged, so saved selections keep working.
- The WebGL context asks for the default power preference, so dual-GPU Macs can stay on the integrated GPU.

### Manual bundle patch (November 2026)

No Node toolchain was available when these changes were made, so the same edits were applied by hand to the Lunalyr entry point at the end of `Sources/Resources/WavefieldEngine.html`: `lunalyrTuneForDesktop` (the preset table above) and its use on the template list (`um`), the `powerPreference` of the renderer (`fm`), and the `calm`/`punch` handling in `draw` (`Bm`, using `lunalyrCalm` and `lunalyrTransient`). The rest of the bundle is unchanged. Rebuilding with `Scripts/build-wavefield-engine.sh` reproduces the same behaviour from the TypeScript; the script also applies the Skeleton name to `WavefieldPresets.json`.

## Every hop of audio

The host sends one 2048-sample window plus a 1024-sample hop for each hop of audio since the page's last frame (at most eight hops), encoded once per frame for every display. `lunalyr-engine.ts` runs Wavefield's window, FFT and temporal tracker on each hop, oldest first, and keeps the strongest beat, pulse, change and onsets any hop found, so a 15 fps wallpaper no longer skips a third of the audio. The same edit was applied by hand to the bundle (`lunalyrDecodePCM`, `Rm`, `lunalyrStrongest` and the analysis loop in `Bm`).
